# Fleet performance by class for recent period (doy 90-121)
recent_trips = tables['trips'][(tables['trips']['fished_date_doy'] >= 90) & (tables['trips']['fished_date_doy'] <= 121)]

by_class_day = recent_trips.groupby(['fished_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
